QuestInfo.name: Maya's First Collection
QuestInfo.1: I got a request from #p207# of #m10001000#, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants #b20 of each#k of the following: #b#t4000009##k, #b#t4000013##k, #b#t4000016##k, and #b#t4000019##k. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...
QuestInfo.2: I got everything #p207# asked for, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??

0.0: Hey, you're the one who got me the medicine! I'm feeling much better now, thanks to you. And you look good too. You look strong, perhaps even stronger than #p0000221#! Hehe, just kidding.
0.1: Anyway, can you do me a favor? I'm collecting some odds and ends, in hopes of creating something amazing with them! Can you help me grab a few things?

yes.0: Thanks! Can you get #b20 each#k of #b#t4000009#s#k, #b#t4000013#s#k, #b#t4000016#s#k, and #b#t4000019#s#k? Do you think it'll be too boring to hunt weak monsters? Hehe... Well, this is just the beginning. Then, I'll leave it to you!

no.0: Oh, you must be really busy right now... but please get back to me if you have time later. I would like to get everything myself, but I'm not fully recovered...

1.0: Wow! You got them all! This was too easy for you, right? Anyway, thank you for the items, but I'm not done yet...

yes.0: I got it. Thank you so much! But I still need many more items, so please talk to me again when you're ready!

item.0: You haven't collected #b20 each#k of #b#t4000009##k, #b#t4000013##k, #b#t4000016##k, and #b#t4000019##k... Keep at it! I'll give you something good if you do.
